blocking.issue: After a crash, the session page shows two different amounts for the session's spend. The fix made the end line use the cost ledger, but recovery never updates the session row's spent_usd_micro. So GET /sessions/:id (the 'Spent of this session's budget' card and the session lists) keeps the stale live amount, which leaves out the critic's spend. The runner's own end writes spent_usd_micro from the same ledger sum (runner.ts:2967); endDeadSession computes that sum (recovery.ts:138) and puts it only on the session.ended event (recovery.ts:161). The acceptance asks that the page read 'its real spend after the restart', and design §1 says 'What the app says is true now'; the page does not hold to either. Validation rule 8 (fix the siblings) is unmet: the session row is the sibling of the line that was fixed.
blocking.evidence: Bench walk B: /tmp/frbench/review-leftovers7-session-evidence/bench-steps/19-b1-session-after-crash.png shows 'Spent of this session's budget CHF 0.00 of CHF 5.00 (0%)' above the last line 'Interrupted: Forerunner closed: 1 done. CHF 0.01.' After the restart, GET /sessions/01a1bc87-782e-… returned spent.usdMicro 6097, the coder run alone. The cost_ledger rows for that session sum to 16014 (runs: coder 6097, critic 9917). The test session-recovery.test.ts 'a session that finished a task before the crash…' checks only the last event line and lastSession. It never reads GET /sessions/:id spent, and it seeds no ledger rows (it uses session.recordSpend), so the gap cannot show there.
blocking.expected: endDeadSession should write spent_usd_micro = the ledger's usd_micro on the session row (in the setStatus or a patch), as the runner's end does when the ledger has rows. The recovery test should seed ledger rows for both the coder and the critic and assert that GET /sessions/:id spent equals the amount in the end line (and the CHF the Overview shows), across the restart.

non_blocking: The Inbox card for a review paused at a budget reuses the run-pause body: 'It stopped before it could say where it stood; its work so far is kept.' (request-words.ts:612). This is untrue when the coder finished and only the review waits (bench step 08). The runner passes handoff: null (runner.ts:2075), so polish has no state to word this differently. A flag on the card, such as review: true, would let polish write 'The work is done; its review waits for room in the budget.'

Chat turn reorder: the message is now '<line>\n\n# Now…' with the line first. The system prompt still says 'Project doc excerpts and lessons from memory may follow the session facts in the first message' (agent.ts:357), and nothing tells the model the first paragraph is the person's line. The bench role-player was changed to read stableChars, so the stand-in cannot catch a model that answers the facts. The live check should confirm that real replies answer the line, with a long facts block (tasks, last session, retrieved docs).

The R-criticcred refused-key path is not tested: critic provider_auth gives a credential_refused run, the row reads 'Waits for a new API key', and saving a key starts the review. Only the usage-limit review is tested. The acceptance named 'subscription only'; the test uses an API key.
packages/critic has no unit test of refusedReviewError or credentialRunOutcome. They are covered only by composed runtime tests.

Intermediate commits are not green. 8de7f51 breaks two tasks.test.tsx cases, 266cb83 breaks four UI chat cases, and b48a67c breaks real-daemon C-68, until 7f886af, whose subject 'bench: …' hides the UI test updates. The commits cannot be bisected.

The R-estimates real-daemon case compares against planEstimateUsdMicro(rt.estimates, row), not GET /projects/:id/start-check (the Start dialog's route). Both use the same function today, but the boundary would be start-check. On the bench, the learned figure moved between card and dialog after the stopped session (18684 to 14412 USD micro); this is true-now behaviour.
GET /inbox now calls store.project.get for every request row, not only plan cards, and shapes each plan on every poll (server.ts around :1760). Hand this to leftovers7-web, which owns R-inboxperf.
When the ledger has no rows, recovery falls back to DEFAULT_CHF_PER_USD, not the configured rate, for last_session.spentChfMicro (recovery.ts around :141).
The plan card's per-task CHF values do not add up to the total once rounded: 'about CHF 0.01' plus 'about CHF 0.02' with 'About CHF 0.04 for the 2 tasks'. This rounding existed before; polish.
'it goes on by itself once that limit is raised or resets' is said of a project budget, which never resets (result.ts:392, task-words.ts:250). The sentence comes from group 4 and is polish's.
Tiny budgets give 'Stopped at the project's budget of CHF 0.01. CHF 0.00.' The fixer reported this; it existed before.
On upgrade, ready tasks given back by a pre-fix session with the old reason no longer read 'Waits until …' while the project waits; they show Ready. The wake still starts them.

A review refused at the task's own budget pauses with Continue. Going on reruns the specialist first (not_done 1: no review-only pass), which spends part of the added budget before the review, so Continue may have to be pressed again.
